data.title: A Bear's Menu
data.questionObjective: The student will be able to: • Describe the seasonal cycle of a bear’s life by examining its eating habits. • Recognize the shape and size of an adult grizzly bear and compare it to his/her own body size. • Describe how to distinguish black and grizzly bears.
